issues.failure_explanation: Condition F only gives continuity of $\mathcal I^{-1}$ on $H^\eta_0$ for $\eta\ge\eta_0$. The proof applies (fishinvbd) with $\eta=\kappa$ (to place $\bar\psi\in H^\kappa_0$), but (ks) only forces $\kappa<k-d/2$, so $k>\eta_0$ does not guarantee $\kappa\ge\eta_0$. Moreover, in (momhat) the step $\langle\mathcal I^{-1}\Delta e_j,\mathcal I^{-1}\Delta e_j\rangle\le\lambda_j^2\|\mathcal I^{-2}e_j\|_{H^{\eta_0}}\|e_j\|_{H^{-\eta_0}}$ tacitly uses self-adjointness of $\mathcal I^{-1}$ on $L^2$, which is not established ($\mathcal I=\Delta\mathbb I^*\mathbb I$ is not self-adjoint in general); the bound available from Condition F is $\|\mathcal I^{-1}e_j\|_{L^2}\lesssim\|e_j\|_{H^{\eta_0}}\simeq\lambda_j^{\eta_0/2}$, which makes the series converge only if $k>\eta_0+d/2$.

failure_location.quote: Suppose Conditions \ref{priorgen} and \ref{gemol} hold for some integer $\gamma>\max(3\zeta + (3d/2)+2, \eta_0)$ and $k> \max(\zeta + (5d/2), \eta_0)$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the hypothesis by $k>\max(\zeta+5d/2,\eta_0+d/2)$ (so that $\kappa\ge\eta_0$ can be chosen) and bound $\|\mathcal I^{-1}e_j\|_{L^2}\lesssim\|e_j\|_{H^{\eta_0}}$ directly in (momhat); the application with $k>3d$ still satisfies this.
issues.overall_effect: As stated, Theorem mainbvm's hypothesis on $k$ does not support two steps of its proof (the regularity of $\bar\psi$ and the moment bound (momhat)); in the application (bvminv, $k>3d$, $\eta_0$ just above $2+d/2$) the required inequalities hold, so the concrete results are unaffected.
issues.title: Hypothesis k > eta_0 in Theorem mainbvm does not cover the uses of Condition F in the proof
issues.why_classification: A standard tightening of a parameter hypothesis and a one-line re-estimate preserve the theorem and all applications without changing method, rate or scope.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: \|P_{E_J}\phi - \phi\|_{L^2} \le c \|\phi\|_{\mathcal H} J^{-\gamma},~~\|P_{E_J}\phi\|_{\mathcal H} \le c \max(1,J^{\gamma - r}) \|\phi\|_{H^r},~~\forall \phi \in L^2_0(\Omega),
J_N \in \mathbb N, J_N \simeq N \delta_N^2,~~K_N = K_{N,\bar \kappa} = \sqrt N \delta_N \max(1,J_N^{\gamma-\bar \kappa}).

issues.failure_explanation: With $E_J$ spanned by the first $J+1$ eigenfunctions and $\lambda_j\simeq j^{2/d}$, the correct bounds are $\|P_{E_J}\phi-\phi\|_{L^2}\lesssim J^{-\gamma/d}\|\phi\|_{\mathcal H}$ and $\|P_{E_J}\phi\|_{\mathcal H}\lesssim J^{(\gamma-r)/d}\|\phi\|_{H^r}$; the stated first bound is false for $d\ge2$. Consequently $K_N$ in (approxrkhs) and the set $\bar\Theta_N$ are built with $J_N^{\gamma-\bar\kappa}$ instead of $J_N^{(\gamma-\bar\kappa)/d}$, and with $J_N\simeq N^{d/(2\gamma+d)}$ the displayed quantity $\delta_N^2\sqrt N J_N^{\gamma-\bar\kappa}$ equals $N^{(2\gamma(d-1)+d-2d\bar\kappa)/(2(2\gamma+d))}$, which diverges for $d\ge2$ and large $\gamma$; the asserted equality with $N^{-(\bar\kappa-d/2)/(2\gamma+d)}$ only holds with the corrected exponent. The same slip appears in (quadbd) and in the $J_N^{-\kappa}$ approximation step of Theorem laplaceapp.

failure_location.quote: \frac{|t|}{\sqrt N} |\langle \theta, p_N(\bar \psi_{\theta_0})\rangle_{\mathcal H_N}| \lesssim |t| \delta_N K_{N, \bar \kappa} \lesssim \delta_N^2 \sqrt N J_N^{\gamma-\bar \kappa} = N^{-(\bar \kappa -d/2)/(2\gamma+d)} \to 0

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct (approxh) to $J^{-\gamma/d}$ and $J^{(\gamma-r)/d}$ (equivalently define $E_J$ by frequency cutoff $|k_j|\le J$ and $J_N^d\simeq N\delta_N^2$), and propagate to $K_N$, $\sigma_N$, (quadbd) and the $p_N$-approximation step; all final exponents then match those claimed.
issues.overall_effect: As literally written, the localisation set $\bar\Theta_N$ in Theorem postcont and the Cameron–Martin/Laplace-transform steps of Theorem mainbvm rely on a false approximation bound and a divergent estimate for $d\ge2$; the intended (corrected-exponent) computation gives the stated limits.
issues.title: Approximation bounds (approxh) have wrong exponents for d>=2, breaking the Cameron–Martin estimate as written
issues.why_classification: A mechanical, forced correction of exponents restores every displayed limit; no result, rate or scope changes.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: For the second term we have from $\vartheta-\vartheta_0 = \sqrt N(\theta-\theta_0)$
we have $\Pi^{\bar \Theta_N}(\|\theta-\theta_0\|_{H^{-k-2}}> 1 |Z^{(N)})=0$ from some $N$ onwards so the third term equals zero eventually

issues.failure_explanation: The integration region is $\{\|\vartheta-\vartheta_0\|>1\}=\{\sqrt N\|\theta-\theta_0\|_{H^{-k-2}}>1\}$, but the proof replaces it by $\{\|\theta-\theta_0\|>1\}$. With the correct region the posterior probability is not exponentially small (the contraction rate $\tilde\delta_N\gg N^{-1/2}$), the second term is of order $\sqrt N\tilde\delta_N\to\infty$, and the third term is not zero since $\sqrt N L\tilde\delta_N\to\infty$ on $\bar\Theta_N$. The decomposition via the unit ball therefore does not prove the claim.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound $W_1(\tau_N,\bar\tau_N)\le\sqrt N\int_{\bar\Theta_N^c}\|\theta-\theta_0\|d\Pi(\cdot|Z^{(N)})+\sqrt N(\Pi(\bar\Theta_N|Z^{(N)})^{-1}-1)\int_{\bar\Theta_N}\|\theta-\theta_0\|d\Pi(\cdot|Z^{(N)})$ and use (ratekey), (meanreg) and Cauchy–Schwarz to get $O_P(\sqrt N\tilde\delta_N e^{-bN\delta_N^2/2})$.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Proposition wassconv is invalid as written; the statement itself remains true via a different decomposition, so downstream use in Theorem mainbvm is unaffected once repaired.
issues.title: Tail terms in the proof of Proposition wassconv drop the factor sqrt N and are not small
issues.why_classification: A short routine re-decomposition using the same ingredients (Theorem postcont) proves the proposition unchanged.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: [This bound actually holds for $\zeta=0$ but the chaining inequality to be used below with envelopes $F_N$ would not allow us to take advantage of it because of the `Poissonian' regime of Bernstein's inequality.]

issues.failure_explanation: The class $f_{\theta,\psi}$ consists of linearisation remainders, but the proof bounds their $L^2$ size only linearly ($\sigma_N\simeq\tilde\delta_N(\zeta)$) via Condition B. The first term of the chaining bound is $\sqrt N\|F_N\|\mathscr J_N(\sigma_N/\|F_N\|)\simeq\sqrt N\int_0^{\sigma_N}u^{-d/2\beta}du\simeq\sqrt N\sigma_N^{1-d/2\beta}$, which with $\sigma_N\simeq\tilde\delta_N(\zeta)\gg N^{-1/2}$ diverges; the displayed evaluation $\sqrt N\tilde\delta_N^{2-d/\beta}(\zeta)$ is a miscalculation ($\int_0^{\sigma}u^{-d/2\beta}du\simeq\sigma^{1-d/2\beta}$, not $\sigma^{2-d/\beta}$). Hence the proof does not establish the claimed $o(1)$ bound. The intended quadratic weak variance $\sigma_N^2\lesssim\tilde\delta_N(0)^4$ follows from Condition C ($\|g_{\theta,\psi}\|_{L^2(\mathcal X)}\le c\|\theta_{(t,\psi)}-\theta_0\|_{L^2}^2$) but is not used.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound the weak variance by Condition C: $Ef^2_{\theta,\psi}\lesssim\|\theta_{(t,\psi)}-\theta_0\|^4_{L^2}\lesssim\tilde\delta_N(0)^4=:\sigma_N^2$, keep the envelope $\tilde\delta_N(\zeta)$, and redo the chaining computation: the first term becomes $\sqrt N\tilde\delta_N(0)^{2-d/\beta}\to0$ under $\beta>2d$ and $\tilde\delta_N(0)^3=o(N^{-1})$, and the second term is of even smaller order; the stated hypotheses suffice.
issues.overall_effect: The control of the stochastic remainder terms $R_{t,N}$ in Theorem laplaceapp, and thus the Bernstein–von Mises Theorems mainbvm, bvminv and ganzwien, rests on an unproven bound as written.
issues.title: Weak-variance bound in Lemma oldtimer is linear, so the chaining bound cannot be o(1)
issues.why_classification: The central technical estimate must be re-derived with a different variance bound and recomputed entropy integrals; the result and hypotheses survive, but the fix is a contained nontrivial replacement of the argument rather than a local slip.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Then for any $\theta \in \bar \Theta_{N,L}, \psi \in U(\kappa+2, 1)$, and using Condition \ref{gemol}D,

issues.failure_explanation: The entropy bound requires $\|g_{\theta,\psi}-g_{\theta',\psi'}\|_\infty\lesssim\|\theta-\theta'\|_{H^\zeta}+N^{-1/2}\|p_N(\bar\psi-\bar\psi')\|_{H^\zeta}$, i.e. a Lipschitz estimate for $\|\G(\theta_{(t,\psi)})-\G(\theta'_{(t,\psi')})\|_\infty$ between two arbitrary points of the ball. Condition D (zetabus) only controls $\|\G(\theta)-\G(\theta_0)\|_\infty$ relative to the fixed $\theta_0$ and yields no bound in terms of $\|\theta-\theta'\|_{H^\zeta}$ (the displayed $\|\theta-\theta_0\|_{H^\zeta}$ is not a distance in $\theta'$ and cannot feed the covering-number argument). The abstract hypotheses therefore do not support this step; only the application (h2estimate) supplies the two-point version.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Strengthen Condition D to $\|\G(\theta)-\G(\vartheta)\|_{L^\infty}\le c\|\theta-\vartheta\|_{H^\zeta}$ for all $\theta,\vartheta\in U(\zeta,B)\cap H^1$ (already verified in (h2estimate)) and correct the displayed term to $\|\theta-\theta'\|_{H^\zeta}$.
issues.overall_effect: Theorem mainbvm, as an abstract result under Condition gemol, is not proved without a strengthened Condition D; the reaction-diffusion application (bvminv, ganzwien) satisfies the stronger condition via (h2estimate).
issues.title: Lemma oldtimer needs a two-point sup-norm Lipschitz bound, but Condition D is only stated at theta_0
issues.why_classification: Adding a standard local condition that the application already verifies restores the proof with no change to conclusions, rates or scope.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: noting that the $C^1([0,T], C^1)$-norm of $V=f'(\tilde u)$ is bounded by a fixed constant $M=M(B)>0$ whenever $\bar \gamma>3+d/2$
where $\|f'(\tilde u)\|_{H^\zeta}$ can be bounded as in the proof of Proposition \ref{roundrobin} by a constant depending only on $f$ and $B \ge \|\theta\|_{H^\zeta} + \|\vartheta\|_{H^\zeta}$

The inequality (\ref{zetabus}) in Condition D) follows from (\ref{h2estimate}) and the continuity of $\mathbb I_{\theta_0}$ required in D) follows from (\ref{izeta}). The stability estimate E) follows from (\ref{dochparis})

issues.failure_explanation: The mean value parameter $s=s(t,x)$ depends on the point, so $\tilde u$ is merely a measurable function with no differentiability in $t$ or $x$; the chain-rule computations of $\|f'(\tilde u(t))\|_{C^1}$, $\|V'(t)\|_{C^1}$ (needed for Lemma paristexas / (dochparis)) and of $\|f'(\tilde u)\|_{H^\zeta}$ (needed for (h2estimate)) are therefore unjustified as written. The verification of Conditions D and E in Theorem bvminv relies on these bounds.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the integral form $f(a)-f(b)=(a-b)\int_0^1 f'(b+s(a-b))ds$, i.e. $V(t,x)=\int_0^1 f'(u_{\theta_0}+s(u_\theta-u_{\theta_0}))(t,x)ds$, which is $C^1$ in time and $C^1$/$H^\zeta$ in space by Proposition roundrobin and Minkowski's inequality; the same bounds then follow.
issues.overall_effect: The verification of Condition E via (dochparis) and Condition D via (h2estimate) is incomplete as written, affecting Theorems bvminv and ganzwien until repaired.
issues.title: Pointwise mean-value function tilde u is treated as C^1 in time and space when bounding the potential norms for Conditions D and E
issues.why_classification: A routine local rewriting of the mean-value step yields the same constants and preserves all claims.

issues.failure_explanation: By Taylor's theorem $|m(t,x)|\le\frac12\|f''\|_\infty|w(t,x)|^2$ with $w=u_{\theta_0+h}-u_{\theta_0}$, so $\|m(t)\|_{L^2}\lesssim\|w(t)\|_{L^4}^2$, not $\|w(t)\|_{L^2}^2$. The inequality $\|m(t)\|_{L^2}\lesssim\sup_t\|w(t)\|_{L^2}^2$ is false in general: at $t\to0$, $\|m(0)\|_{L^2}\simeq\|h\|_{L^4}^2$, and for $h\in U(\bar\gamma,B)$ one only has $\|h\|_{L^4}\lesssim\|h\|_{L^2}^{1-\alpha}$, so $\|h\|_{L^4}^2/\|h\|_{L^2}^2$ is unbounded. Thus (quadap) is not established by the given argument.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Prove (quadap) by an energy estimate with the source in $H^{-1}$: $\frac12\frac{d}{dt}\|r\|^2+\|\nabla r\|^2\le C\|r\|^2+\|m\|_{H^{-1}}\|r\|_{H^1}$, with $\|m\|_{H^{-1}}\lesssim\|w^2\|_{L^{2d/(d+2)}}=\|w\|_{L^{4d/(d+2)}}^2\lesssim\|w\|_{L^2}^{2-d/2}\|w\|_{H^1}^{d/2}$ (Gagliardo–Nirenberg, $d\le3$) and the energy bounds $\sup_t\|w\|_{L^2}^2+\int_0^T\|\nabla w\|^2\lesssim\|h\|_{L^2}^2$, giving $\int_0^T\|m\|_{H^{-1}}^2\lesssim\|h\|_{L^2}^4$.
issues.overall_effect: Condition C for the reaction-diffusion forward map (used in Theorem bvminv and, through the $L^2$-remainder bound, in the proof of Theorem ganzwien) is unproven as written; the estimate (quadap) itself appears true but needs a different argument.
issues.title: Quadratic remainder bound in Theorem linrob confuses L^4 with L^2 norms
issues.why_classification: The stated inference is false and must be replaced by a contained new parabolic/interpolation argument; the conclusion and all dependent results survive, so no mathematical content is lost.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: In summary, we have shown that $-\mathcal I = Id +K$ on $H^\eta$ for a compact operator $K: H^\eta \to H^\eta$.
\mathbb I_\theta^* \mathbb I_\theta = \mathbb I_{\theta, \varepsilon}^* \mathbb I_{\theta, \varepsilon}  + \varepsilon K_2 = -\Delta^{-1} +K_{1,\varepsilon} +\varepsilon  K_2

issues.failure_explanation: Since $\partial_s U(s)=\Delta U(s)-WU(s)$, one has $\int_0^{\varepsilon/4}(\Delta U-WU)(2t)dt=\frac12[U(\varepsilon/2)-U(0)]$, so $A(h)=-\frac12 h+\frac12U^{(\varepsilon)}_h(\varepsilon/2)+\int_0^{\varepsilon/4}WU_h(2t)dt$ and $-\mathcal I=\frac12 Id+K$, not $Id+K$ (this is confirmed by the exact time-constant computation $\mathbb I^*\mathbb I=\frac12(-\sS_W)^{-1}(1-e^{2T\sS_W})$). The proof's asserted decomposition and the formula $-\Delta^{-1}$ in (infoapprox) are off by the factor 2.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Insert the factor $\frac12$ (write $-2\mathcal I=Id+K'$ with $K'$ compact) and replace $-\Delta^{-1}$ by $-\frac12\Delta^{-1}$ in (infoapprox).
issues.overall_effect: The conclusion of Theorem raf is unaffected (the Fredholm alternative applies equally to $cId+K$, $c\neq0$), but the proof's displayed decomposition and the quantitative description of $\mathbb I^*\mathbb I$ in Remark clever are incorrect by a constant factor.
issues.title: Missing factor 1/2 in the identity-plus-compact decomposition of the information operator
issues.why_classification: A constant-factor correction leaves the theorem, its proof structure and all downstream results intact.
